Name: Void's RainbowTrail retexture
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
This is a simple tetexture of the RainbowTrail from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16914]Aedenthorn's RainbowTrail[/url]﻿! At first I was just playing around to see if little images instead of gradients can be used and how it looked (one option in this mod is this test, the shrimp of illusion, one little pal that came into existence in the #modded-farmers channel on the sdv discord).

There is a total of 14 gradients and the shrimp of illusions. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
